headline: Thessaloniki: "Landing" of caïques at Thermaikos, next to the White Tower – Fishermen in despair (PHOTO + VIDEO)
summary: Fishermen brought caïques to Thermaikos near Thessaloniki to protest the tripling of diesel prices. Reports say many caïques have gone bankrupt.
why: Diesel is a major operating cost for small fishing fleets, so fuel price spikes hit fishing incomes and the local seafood supply chain directly.
